tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night is the default theme: the feed is a dark room where the heat glows.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, rows, panels sitting on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or pressed areas inside a surface: code blocks, inputs, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, dividers between rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on night, surface and surface-2 (above 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, timestamps on night and surface (above 6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Cold, 0 to 39°. Also upTake's blue: the bridge between the two products. Text on it: on-cold.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Mild, 40 to 59°. Text on it: on-cold.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Warm, 60 to 74°. Text on it: on-hot.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Hot, 75 to 89°. Text on it: on-hot.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Scorching, 90° and up, and the one primary action per screen. Text on it: on-hot.

tokens.name: on-cold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on heat-0 and heat-1 fills (above 5:1).

tokens.name: on-hot
tokens.usage: Text and icons on heat-2, heat-3 and heat-4 fills (above 4.5:1).

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Brand-safe sticker and success states only. Never a heat level.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Handle-with-care sticker and warnings. Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: cooled
tokens.usage: A trend that has passed: its title, degree and thermal field turn this grey.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px, 2px offset.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The trend of the day, on its card. Condensed (font-stretch 62%), lowercase, two lines at most.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Trend titles on story cards and trend pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The second trailer dropped and every gaming channel is reacting.
styles.usage: Running text: why a trend rises, post angles.

styles.name: degree-xl
styles.usage: Heat of the trend of the day.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Ranks, deltas, dates, the ticker, code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside stickers, between a degree and its unit.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips; story progress bars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, gaps inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a feed.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Code blocks, inputs, sparkline frames.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, angle cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Story cards (9:16), like a phone screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, stickers, heat badges.

tokens.name: glow-hot
tokens.usage: The trend-of-the-day card only. One per screen.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Cards in the feed, menus.
